subject: Programming and DS: Data Structures
name: Binary Search Tree
priorityEvidence: 36 PYQs extracted, tested 1996-2025 continuously. Fifth topic in study order, direct extension of Binary Tree with an ordering invariant.

prerequisites.why: BST is a Binary Tree with the additional left<root<right ordering invariant at every node.

unlocks.why: AVL Tree is a height-balanced BST — this topic's insert/delete/search are the base operations AVL rebalances around.
B-Trees generalize the BST ordering idea to multi-way nodes for disk-based indexing.
